ALPHABET CENTER · LETTER M

Letter M — Moon.

A green crescent moon glows for the letter M. M is the humming letter — mmm — and the moon is the quietest, coziest word in the set.

Meet the letter, hear its sound, trace it together — then play. Everything on this page is free, gentle and paced for you.

THE LETTER SOUND

What does M say?

“m — mmm, a humming sound”

M says mmm — the only sound you can hum with your mouth closed. Say mmmm while patting your tummy like you just ate something wonderful.

TRACE THE LETTER

Trace M m together.

Follow the numbers with a finger — on screen or on each other’s palms. The arrows show the way to go, the numbers show where to start, and a grown-up reads the little script below each card. Slow and wobbly is exactly right.

Trace the uppercase M

Start at 1 at the top left, pull straight down. Lift. Start at 2 at the top left again, slide down the hill to the middle valley. Lift. Start at 3 in the valley, slide up to the top right. Lift. Pull straight down.

Trace the lowercase m

Start at 1, pull straight down. Lift. Start at 2 on the stem, arch over and pull straight down. Lift. Start at 3 at the same spot, arch over again and pull straight down.

TAKE IT OFF SCREEN

Moon light.

Two minutes is plenty. Follow your child’s lead and stop while it is still fun — that is the whole method.

  1. 01

    Turn off the lamp for one minute and pretend to be moonlight drifting around the room, humming mmmm.

  2. 02

    Find three white or round things in the dark and name them.

  3. 03

    Turn the light back on with a big mmm-ON!

PLAY & PRACTICE

Games that use this letter.

The games mix every letter — play them after meeting two or three letters, or any day your child asks. No scores, no timers, no wrong answers that count.
